results.sql: with f as (select payment_month, case when procedure_code like '81%' or procedure_code like '%U' then 'molecular' when procedure_code like '80%' then 'chemistry' when procedure_code like '87%' then 'microbiology' when procedure_code like '8%' then 'other lab' else 'other' end as test_family, line_paid_amount from sem.remit_lines where is_current_adjudication), g as (select payment_month, test_family, sum(line_paid_amount) as paid from f group by 1,2) select strftime(payment_month,'%Y-%m') as payment_month, test_family, round(paid,2) as line_paid_dollars, round(100.0*paid/sum(paid) over (partition by payment_month),1) as share_pct from g order by 1,2

results.sql: WITH fam AS (SELECT payment_month, CASE WHEN procedure_code LIKE '81%' OR procedure_code LIKE '%U' THEN 'molecular' WHEN procedure_code LIKE '80%' THEN 'chemistry' WHEN procedure_code LIKE '87%' THEN 'microbiology' WHEN procedure_code LIKE '8%' THEN 'other lab' ELSE 'other' END AS test_family, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication), by_family AS (SELECT payment_month, test_family, SUM(line_paid_amount) AS family_paid FROM fam GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS payment_month, test_family, ROUND(family_paid, 2) AS line_paid_dollars, ROUND(100.0 * family_paid / SUM(family_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY payment_month), 1) AS share_of_month_pct FROM by_family ORDER BY payment_month, test_family
